source_row.rationale: Hypertonic saline works through an osmotic mechanism similar to mannitol to reduce cerebral edema, but requires monitoring of serum sodium levels, given the risk of significant electrolyte shifts with this concentrated saline solution, an important safety consideration during administration.
source_row.source_name: Clinical Neurocritical Care References — Hypertonic Saline for ICP Management
